description: DEDDIAG, a domestic electricity demand dataset of individual appliances in Germany is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Marc Wenninger, Jochen Schmidt. The dataset contains recordings of 15 homes over a period of up to 3.5 years, wherein total 50 appliances have been recorded at a frequency of 1 Hz. Recorded appliances are of significance for load-shifting purposes such as dishwashers, washing machines and refrigerators. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 15301180457 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
